main_text.head: DE CONIVNCTIONE CIVITATIS CVM TRANSLAVICANIS.
main_text.p: Fœdus cum Octopagicis.IN Translavicanis Octopagici, Cislavicanis finitimi, primi post Scingios à Kenone Groninga eiectos, commodo societatis cum civitate animadverso, isdem conditionibus, quibus Hummercij, Langowoldij, Fredowoldij in commune fœdus ascripti, eidem quoq; se potestati praetoriæ subiecere, & eadem, quæ inde profluunt commoda civitati tribuerunt, cum annus fueret à nato Christo M. cccc. xvi: tempusq; fœderi dederunt decennium. Deinde finito decennio, cum utilitatem rei essent experti, metuerentq; priora mala tφόροις demptis, fœdus idem indefinite, nullo statuto termino prorogarunt, additis etiam ad priores

page.notes: The initial "I" of "IN" is a woodcut initial; read as I. Greek word "tφόροις" is rendered as printed with a doubtful first letter; left as printed. Bottom line "priores" is the last line of the page; no catchword or signature visible. Left margin note reads "Fœdus cum Octopagicis." Some ink and show-through present; not transcribed.
